description:
## Goal

Diagnose a source call whose argument cannot satisfy the declared foreign parameter type at the shared front end. Do not make the interpreter silently coerce it while native execution aborts. Source ABI declarations are contracts, not requests for automatic numeric conversion.

## Focused witness

```fz
extern "C" defp libc::sqrt(float) :: float
def main(), do: libc::sqrt(9)
```

The integer argument is incompatible with the declared float parameter. The valid counterpart uses 9.0. The old audit observed interpreter coercion to 3.0 and native failure. Reproduce at the current head rather than relying on historical behavior.

## Ownership

This ticket owns shared source-call semantic checking and its source diagnostic before any execution door runs. fz-kdt.164 owns the distinct interpreter invariant when an actual Int reaches a supposedly F64 runtime lane after dispatch/lowering. Do not duplicate or remove its marshal_arg runtime check or close it merely because this static source witness is rejected.

Language-level mixed arithmetic remains legal through the explicitly selected typed arithmetic exports (for example fz_op_add_if(integer,float)); do not remove ordinary numeric conversions inside those operations. fz-5xp.30 owns truthful exports and scalar-pair returns, .32 owns runtime physical-export validation. This source argument check applies to open-world externs too and is not a manifest lookup.

## Strategy and acceptance

1. Inspect existing source call/contract validation and use the same resolved Ty relation. Preserve aliases, constraints and diagnostics ownership. Do not classify arguments by display strings or wait until native codegen to reject a source type mismatch.
2. TDD the invalid integer-to-float source witness and valid float, valid integer-to-integer, source type aliases, and ordinary mixed arithmetic. All three doors share the same source diagnostic/location and never call the foreign function for the rejected case.
3. Preserve legitimate dynamic dispatch and typed foreign calls. A runtime value violating an already-established lane is kdt.164's separate tripwire, not a reason to broaden valid source types to Any.
4. Update extern/source-contract docs, run focused and full relevant gates, and obtain a fresh cold Sol-high scoped review before one commit/close and prompt stack push.

No dependency on .30 is necessary for the existing scalar source witness. Discuss this ticket's plan before construction; do not silently absorb it into the aggregate-return work.
title: Reject source arguments incompatible with a declared foreign parameter type
